en.headline: Medical Certificate Helps
en.hook: Did you know a medical check can secure your will?
en.what: A medical assessment can help prove you're fit to make a will. This is especially useful for older people. It's not required by law, though.
en.why: It matters because it can prevent disputes over your will. Getting a medical certificate can give you peace of mind.
